messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] kv-cache slab-pressure spike detected. p95 for streaming routes -> 1.8s, p99 -> 6.2s. Eviction rate up x6 in last 5m. Affected region: us-east-1. Triggered 2026-03-14T18:05:21Z
Alex F.: seeing streaming stalls on /v1/stream — partial frames, client reconnects. Tail latency spikes correlate with heavy decode load on a subset of shards.
Maria C.: digging in — prefill hit rate dropped while decode miss rate climbed. Looks like prefill vs decode size skew: lots of tiny prefill entries, but decodes need large contiguous blocks -> fragmentation.
Kyle O.: assigning oncall. @OncallRotation Kyle, you have it?
OncallRotation: oncall ack — joining.
Jenna L.: customer impact check? any paid tenants reporting errors?
Alex F.: two tenants reported elevated retries: deepchat (~0.9% error increase) and reco-inc (~1.8% retry rate). Roughly 12-18k rps window affected, mostly streaming sessions. No data leak.
Maria C.: digging in — prefill hit rate dropped while decode miss rate climbed. Looks like prefill vs decode size skew: lots of tiny prefill entries, but decodes need large contiguous blocks -> fragmentation.
Maria C.: quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle prefill workers to stop adding fragmented entries; 2) bump slab target percent to reduce fragmentation; 3) run manual eviction/compaction on hot shards; 4) divert noncritical streaming to dedicated pool.
Kyle O.: steps pls. I'll implement traffic diversion once we agree.
Maria C.: executing now.
Maria C.: step 1: scale prefill down
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment prefill-worker --replicas=1
```
step 2: patch kv-config map (increase slab target, restrict prefill on big payloads)
```
# kv-config.yaml (patch)
kv.slab.target_percent: 85 -> 92
kv.prefill.enabled_for_size_gt_bytes: 65536 -> 131072
```
step 3: manual eviction to free contiguous segments (compact policy)
```
./scripts/kv_eviction_force.py --shard 7 --policy compact --dry-run=false
```
Applying now — ETA ~2-3m.
Alex F.: also suggest adding header-based routing rule to send noncritical streaming to dedicated pool: header X-Degrade: true -> dedicated. Will reduce load on shared cache.
Kyle O.: I'll add a canary rule to gateway.
DeployBot: Rollout started: gateway/routing-rules@canary by Kyle O.
IncidentBot: :information_source: Customer impact summary: DeepChat 0.9% error increase; Reco-inc 1.8% retry increase. Estimated affected traffic ~15k req/min at peak. No PII.
Jenna L.: I'll notify CS + AMs with ETA 10m and what we're doing. Drafting message now.
Alex F.: after manual eviction, immediate effect: p95 -> 230ms, p99 -> 740ms, streaming stalls reduced but not fully fixed. Still seeing tail outliers on shard 7.
Maria C.: shard 7 histogram shows extreme fragmentation (many small allocations, free list churn). Next: slab reshuffle for that shard + offload heavy decodes to dedicated decode pool.
Kyle O.: risk of reshuffle? live safe?
Maria C.: slab-reshuffle is online-safe, no restart required. Command: 
```
optool --cluster prod kv slab-reshuffle --shards 7
```
Kicking it now.
Alex F.: reshuffle started. logs: 
```
[18:12:05] shard=7 reshuffle:start nodes=6
[18:12:12] shard=7 compaction: freed=1.2GB contiguous
[18:12:30] shard=7 reshuffle:complete duration=25s
```
IncidentBot: :status: post-mitigation snapshot — p95=210ms, p99=620ms, streaming error-rate down ~70% from peak.
Kyle O.: leaving traffic diversion in place for 20m to be safe. Will lift if stable. Maria — please open a followup ticket and attach the graphs and config diff.
Maria C.: creating INC-2026-317 now. Assigning eng-sre + infra. Including steps, commands run, slab histograms and tenant impact.
Jenna L.: CS update sent to DeepChat and Reco-inc. Included mitigation steps and ETA to monitor.
Kyle O.: night oncall handoff at 20:00 UTC — @OncallRotation you'll take it after me.
OncallRotation: acknowledged. Monitoring p99; will escalate if p99 > 1s for more than 5m or if streaming stalls reoccur.
Alex F.: quick summary for postmortem: root cause = kv cache fragmentation amplified by prefill/decode size imbalance leading to eviction waves and tail stalls on streaming. Immediate mitigations: scale prefill down, increase slab target, manual eviction, slab-reshuffle, route noncritical streaming to dedicated pool. Followups: add smarter prefill sizing, background compaction job, and runbook updates for slab pressure.
Maria C.: will post perf graphs and open a PR to add prefill size gating. Also propose a periodic compaction task to run low-traffic windows.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated — metrics logged. Thread will remain open for monitoring 1h. If stable, we'll close and attach INC-2026-317 to postmortem.
